blueprint.reasoning: Revised architecture addresses all expert feedback: ML theory - added AdamW optimizer with cosine annealing learning rate schedule for convergence guarantees, implemented uncertainty weighting to balance loss functions, and replaced fixed KL warmup with cyclical annealing for dynamic posterior control; Engineering - incorporated PCA dimensionality reduction to 2000 features to reduce decoder parameters for high gene counts, enabled mixed precision training and gradient checkpointing to fit within 12GB GPU memory, and reduced batch size to 32 for feasibility; Methodology - integrated graph attention layers in the decoder to model gene interactions and regulatory networks, added pathway loss for biological priors, and included hierarchical perturbation embeddings to distinguish perturbation types, addressing lack of interaction modeling and biological constraints while maintaining latent space flexibility.
